source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
As your Shooting phase starts, pick 1 enemy unit this model can see within 30". Until the phase ends, for a ranged attack by a **DEATH GUARD** model of yours against the picked unit:

- with a Blast weapon, the Hit roll may be re-rolled
- with any other weapon, a Hit roll of 1 may be re-rolled
